text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy has conquered all of<n>the G1 dirt mile
races!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Zen-Nippon Junior Yushun, the<n>Mile
Championship Nambu Hai, the<n>February Stakes,
and the Kashiwa<n>Kinen—she came first in all of
them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The public's perception of her has<n>done a complete
one-eighty. Even in<n>the academy, her popularity is
skyrocketing!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hm hm hmm. ♪ Hard rice crackers,<n>fried carrot
sticks, and brown-sugar<n>karinto—it all looks so
yummy!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's Windy! Hasn't she been<n>winning nonstop
lately?! Hehe, I<n>wonder what she's buying.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look! Dober and Groove are<n>over there, too!
Don't you ever<n>wonder what the elites do on their
days off?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume point their fingers<n>toward Air
Groove, known as the<n>"Empress," and Mejiro
Dober, a<n>talented member of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...It seems like we're being watched. I<n>really can't
relax when I have eyes<n>on me like this...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're fine. All it means is that<n>you've been
achieving splendid<n>results.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Elite racers need to be capable of<n>dealing with the
attention they're<n>bound to receive. Case in point...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
MWAHAHAHA! Curious about the<n>elites, are we?!
Wanna know what<n>my favorite snacks are?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'd love to know! Are these<n>snacks the
secret to your strength?<n>Then I'll buy some too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, even the stuff I like is startin' to<n>sell like crazy!
I'm a total celebrity<n>now! Neeheehee! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm? Dober and Air Groove, how's it<n>going?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec, why're you all pouty,<n>Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-it's nothing... I'm not being pouty in<n>the slightest...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But, um... can I ask how you remain<n>so composed
while receiving all of<n>this extra attention?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Me? Composed? Hm... I wouldn't<n>say that...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's more like... I'm havin' loads of<n>fun! I love it
when everyone's payin'<n>attention to me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So it's because you're having fun...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But I'm sure you only feel that way<n>thanks to your
extraordinary mental<n>fortitude. ...It's truly
impressive.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Dober! And to the rest of ya!<n>What are
y'all talkin' about?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous! ☆★ I heard somebody say<n>"attention"!
You know, I've also had a<n>bunch of people
watching my every<n>move lately. ☆

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Let us consider their gazes an<n>honor. We
can be proud of the<n>accomplishments that put us in
this<n>position.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Pride, hm? Well, when you put it like<n>that, I guess I
understand...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Joining the conversation is the<n>American-raised
sprinter, Taiki<n>Shuttle...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Along with Grass Wonder and the<n>bubbly yet
mysterious Marvelous<n>Sunday.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, all the ultra elite Umamusume<n>are gathered
here together! The aura<n>they're giving off is wild!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ultra elite?! Do ya mean me? Am I<n>part of that
group?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course. You conquered all the G1<n>dirt mile races.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your endless pranks, it<n>feels like I've
done nothing but scold<n>you over the years... But to
tell the<n>truth, you've surpassed each and<n>every one
of my expectations.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You've done well, Shinko Windy.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
What the heck?! I just got praised by<n>Air Groove!
Someone pinch me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! I knew I was amazing! ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm a prodigy! ♪ I'm the most<n>fearsome
Umamusume around! ♪<n>Heh heh heh!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh, for goodness sake...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I wonder if I'll ever be able to<n>accept my
fame in such a carefree<n>manner.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, everyone! Since I'm in<n>such a good
mood, I'm gonna share<n>the snacks I just bought
with ya!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Let's eat outside! We'll<n>have a snack
party to celebrate my<n>awesomeness!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
A snack party?! Why, that sounds<n>positively
marvelous! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Darn tootin'! We should toast some<n>marshmallows,
too!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. We've all desperately battled<n>through
countless races, so I think<n>taking a break like this
every now<n>and then might be just what we<n>need. ♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Let's hurry up and go! C'mon, race<n>ya there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At some point along the way, Shinko<n>Windy's
impressive talents have<n>earned her a place among
the elite<n>racers who she now calls friends!
